title: RelayHello
description: The agent's first message on the control channel, answering the relay's challenge (ADR 0230 §3): its id, and a compact JWS by the installation's Ed25519 key binding the relay's control URL, the id, the protocol, the nonce of this connection's challenge and an `iat` within 60 seconds of the relay's clock (`x-hello-signature` of `relay.yaml`). One control session per id: a hello that verifies replaces the live one, a hello that does not is refused and the live one kept.

protocol.description: The protocol the agent speaks: 1 for this contract. The relay serves its own and the one before.

agent_version.description: The agent's own release, as a fact to show.

id.description: The id the relay drew at the pairing; the `kid` of the signature.

signature.description: A compact JWS (`alg` `EdDSA`, `typ` `choregos-relay-hello+jwt`, `kid` the id) whose claims are `htu`, `id`, `protocol`, `nonce` and `iat`.
